title: habitat tokens file
description: The YAML front matter of tokens.md. Names, values, tiers and aliases usually come straight from Figma variables; meaning, useFor and avoid come from the designer, because a hex code does not say when to use it.

owner.description: Who approves changes to the tokens.

lastReviewed.description: When a person last checked this file against Figma (YYYY-MM-DD).

collections.description: The Figma variable collections these tokens were read from.

tier.description: primitive: a raw palette value with no meaning of its own (color.teal.600). semantic: a role (color.brand.default), which is what components should bind to. component: a value specific to one component (button.primary.background).

type.description: The kind of value, using the W3C design tokens (DTCG) type names: color, dimension, number, duration, fontFamily, fontWeight, typography, shadow and so on. Optional: habitat guesses it from the value when it is missing.

value.description: The raw value, e.g. '#1f6f6b' or '16px'. A text or effect style is an object, e.g. { fontFamily: Inter, fontSize: 16px, fontWeight: 600, lineHeight: 1.5 }. For modes (light/dark), use 'modes' as well and put the default here.

aliasOf.description: The token this one points to, e.g. a semantic colour pointing at a primitive. Must exist in this file.

modes.description: Optional per-mode values, e.g. { light: '#fff', dark: '#111' }.

figma.description: Where the token lives in Figma: a variable, or a style for libraries that still use styles.

variable.description: The variable's name in Figma, e.g. 'color/brand/default'.

collection.description: The variable collection it belongs to.

style.description: The style's name in Figma, e.g. 'Heading/Large'.

styleType.description: PAINT is a colour or gradient style, TEXT a type style, EFFECT a shadow or blur, GRID a layout grid.

meaning.description: What this token is for, in a sentence.

avoid.description: Where not to use it, and why.

replacedBy.description: Marks the token as deprecated; names the token to use instead.
